other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes dataset-level statistics (e.g., medians, frequency encodings, and grouped aggregations) on the entire training set before entering the cross-validation loop. This causes the training folds to contain features derived from the validation folds' distributions, leading to data leakage and overly optimistic validation scores.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with comprehensive feature engineering, a well-architected TabularResNet alongside gradient boosting models, and a tuned ensemble. However, the solution suffers from data leakage: it peeks at the test set during LabelEncoding and log-transform shifts (FM02), and computes global aggregations/imputations prior to the cross-validation split, leaking validation statistics into the training folds.
